# Preface {.unnumbered}

This document will serve as the central repository for Kenai Watershed Forum's freshwater fish habitat mapping efforts, 2021 - present.

This draft-in-progress is currently is not intended as a public-facing, complete source of information, but it will become so as the work continues.

See the Introduction section for external links to relevant materials related to this project.
